candidates.hook: Catherine mocks, "Your mother's little book of weeds?"
candidates.cliffhanger: Catherine leans in and whispers, "I can burn it," leaving the fate of the herbarium hanging.
candidates.why: A villain’s cruel threat to destroy the heroine’s only legacy creates instant tension and makes viewers want to see if she can stop it.

candidates.hook: The heavy iron door slams shut with a deafening thud as Juliana cries, "Please!"
candidates.cliffhanger: The clip ends on Juliana kneeling in the dark cell, her desperate pleas unheard, leaving her fate unknown.
candidates.why: The visceral confinement and raw pleading hook viewers emotionally and leave the outcome unresolved.

candidates.hook: Catherine coldly says, "You were cast out once."
candidates.cliffhanger: Just as the massive iron door swings open and guards prepare to shove Juliana inside, the clip cuts before she is forced in.
candidates.why: A chilling reminder of Juliana’s past combined with the imminent physical danger builds suspense that compels viewers to watch more.

moments.desc: Catherine mocks, "Your mother's little book of weeds?"
Catherine whispers, "I can burn it," threatening the herbarium.
Juliana sobbing, "Mother..." showing her deep grief.
Juliana V.O. declares, "They took her locket. But they will not take Alexander from me."
